newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Tuesday, as lower prices here relative to producing countries stimulated short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen to 2.1 yen per kg higher, with benchmark March ending 1.0 yen up at 134.9 yen.

Activity was spurred by technical factors amid a dearth of fresh factors, they said. "Private investors were tending to cover shorts in nearby months while building fresh shorts in distant months," one trader said. View that domestic rubber stocks will rise further should limit any further gains, he added.
